payload.summary: Implemented bounded two-window external scheduler, serialized bounded PCM prefetch, exact shared-context sample reuse (keeps model context unchanged), host external POST opt-in concurrency with per-account two-request limit, and worker recycling after eight completed windows. Configured transcription-sources verification passed (149+7 web tests plus Rust/WASM/tsc/lint); additional account server tests 2 passed and new-file lint passed with existing warnings. Live project persisted 27 completed sections (first 65 words, recent 145-157, so density plausibly contributes to latency). Browser initially 5.9GB and unresponsive; development server independently restarted during work. Reopened project and observed restored captions, but automatic resume reported editor storage commit timeout (unknown outcome). Attempted normal Generate transcript retry; browser became unresponsive again. No verified section 28 yet, no actual throughput improvement measured. Scope remains open, do not mark fully implemented.
payload.next: Resolve storage timeout/resume safely preserving canonical session and 27 saved sections; verify live section 28 and benchmark actual inference vs decode/publication. Inference overlap itself has NOT been reduced: only redundant PCM decode/resample is eliminated to preserve boundary accuracy. Consider further measured inference optimization after live recovery.
